question: Would lowering the heap target or watching only host-free memory establish safe admission? What should the repair account for?

criteria.instruction: Neither establishes bounded total admission. v6 omits native, resident mapped and supervisor charges and bounds queue count rather than bytes. Add group charge/headroom telemetry, bounded per-batch/in-flight bytes and total working-set planning, release owned buffers on all paths and test oversized batches. Rename heap-only memory total to avoid misrepresentation.
Join worker inspection and M13/repair rules; mapping is not free residency in the fixture, but virtual mapped size is not automatically the resident charge either.
Do not claim an approved production limit/concurrency value, guaranteed cure from a larger limit, or authority to delete source files/records.
